## Environment Verification

```{r setup}
library(reticulate)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(plotly)
library(pheatmap)
library(tibble)
```

## Data Acquisition & Differential Expression

```{python load-real-dataset}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import warnings

# Suppress scipy precision warnings for zero-variance genes
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# 1. Load your local dataset
df = pd.read_csv("cleaned_expression.csv", index_col=0)

# 2. Transpose it (genes become rows, samples become columns) 
raw_counts = df.T.reset_index().rename(columns={'index': 'gene_id'})

# 3. Grab the first 6 sample names for a 3 vs 3 comparison
sample_names = raw_counts.columns[1:7].tolist()
ctrl_cols = sample_names[0:3]
trt_cols = sample_names[3:6]

# Isolate the gene_id and these 6 samples
expression_matrix = raw_counts[['gene_id'] + ctrl_cols + trt_cols].copy()

# Rename columns to perfectly match our downstream R code
expression_matrix.columns = [
    "gene_id", 
    "Control_Rep1", "Control_Rep2", "Control_Rep3", 
    "Treated_Rep1", "Treated_Rep2", "Treated_Rep3"
]

numeric_cols = ["Control_Rep1", "Control_Rep2", "Control_Rep3", "Treated_Rep1", "Treated_Rep2", "Treated_Rep3"]

# Drop genes that have zero variance across all 6 samples to prevent T-test failure
for col in numeric_cols:
    expression_matrix[col] = pd.to_numeric(expression_matrix[col], errors='coerce')
    
expression_matrix = expression_matrix.dropna()
expression_matrix = expression_matrix[expression_matrix[numeric_cols].var(axis=1) > 0].copy()

# 4. Apply log2 transformation to normalize the real RNA-seq counts
for col in numeric_cols:
    expression_matrix[col] = np.log2(expression_matrix[col] + 1)

# 5. Compute Means and Log2 Fold Change
expression_matrix['Control_Mean'] = expression_matrix[["Control_Rep1", "Control_Rep2", "Control_Rep3"]].mean(axis=1)
expression_matrix['Treated_Mean'] = expression_matrix[["Treated_Rep1", "Treated_Rep2", "Treated_Rep3"]].mean(axis=1)
expression_matrix['Log2FC'] = expression_matrix['Treated_Mean'] - expression_matrix['Control_Mean']

# 6. Perform the T-test
ctrl_matrix = expression_matrix[["Control_Rep1", "Control_Rep2", "Control_Rep3"]].values
trt_matrix = expression_matrix[["Treated_Rep1", "Treated_Rep2", "Treated_Rep3"]].values
t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(trt_matrix, ctrl_matrix, axis=1, equal_var=False)

expression_matrix['p_value'] = p_val
expression_matrix = expression_matrix.dropna(subset=['p_value']).copy()

# Calculate -log10 p-value for the Y-axis of the Volcano plot
expression_matrix['neg_log10_p'] = -np.log10(np.where(expression_matrix['p_value'] == 0, 1e-20, expression_matrix['p_value']))

print(f"Success! Loaded {expression_matrix.shape[0]} real genes from cleaned_expression.csv.")
```

## Results Dashboard {.tabset}

### Interactive Volcano Plot
```{r interactive-volcano}
# Pull the data frame from Python into R
deg_data <- py$expression_matrix

# Categorize genes based on thresholds
deg_data <- deg_data %>%
  mutate(
    Significance = case_when(
      Log2FC >= 1 & p_value < 0.05 ~ "Upregulated",
      Log2FC <= -1 & p_value < 0.05 ~ "Downregulated",
      TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
    )
  )

# Create the base ggplot
base_volcano <- ggplot(deg_data, aes(x = Log2FC, y = neg_log10_p, color = Significance, text = gene_id)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Upregulated" = "#e74c3c",       
    "Downregulated" = "#3498db",     
    "Not Significant" = "#bdc3c7"    
  )) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Log2 Fold Change", y = "-Log10(p-value)")

# Render the interactive widget
ggplotly(base_volcano, tooltip = c("text", "x", "y"))
```

### Significant Genes Table
```{r data-table}
# Format the data for the table
significant_genes <- deg_data %>%
  filter(Significance != "Not Significant") %>%
  arrange(p_value) %>%
  select(gene_id, Control_Mean, Treated_Mean, Log2FC, p_value, Significance) %>%
  mutate(
    Log2FC = round(Log2FC, 2),
    p_value = signif(p_value, 3),
    Control_Mean = round(Control_Mean, 2),
    Treated_Mean = round(Treated_Mean, 2)
  )

# Display the interactive table
datatable(significant_genes, 
          options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE),
          caption = "Differentially Expressed Genes Overview",
          rownames = FALSE)
```

### Expression Heatmap
```{r plot-heatmap}
# Extract the top 30 most significant genes
top_30_genes <- deg_data %>%
  filter(Significance != "Not Significant") %>%
  arrange(p_value) %>%
  head(30) %>%
  pull(gene_id)

# Filter for those genes, strip existing row names, and set gene_id as row names
heatmap_data <- deg_data %>%
  filter(gene_id %in% top_30_genes) %>%
  select(gene_id, Control_Rep1, Control_Rep2, Control_Rep3, Treated_Rep1, Treated_Rep2, Treated_Rep3) %>%
  remove_rownames() %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_id")

# Create an annotation dataframe for the column colors (Treated vs Control)
annotation_col <- data.frame(
  Condition = c(rep("Control", 3), rep("Treated", 3))
)
rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(heatmap_data)

# Generate the heatmap
pheatmap(as.matrix(heatmap_data),
         scale = "row",
         annotation_col = annotation_col,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("#3498db", "white", "#e74c3c"))(50),
         main = "Top 30 Differentially Expressed Genes")
```
